title: The software shipped a year before the chip
subtitle: Filled markers are things that exist. The hollow ones are the chip in customers' hands and the government money, neither of which has happened.

events.label: X0 silicon, XTR-0 dev kit
events.detail: Dozens of XTR-0 systems shipped to early users, per the company.

events.label: Z1 announced
events.detail: 269,568 pbits, under 1 W, under 12 mm on a side.

events.label: Z1 early access
events.detail: Planned for 2027, in two form factors.

events.label: Z1T models
events.detail: Open weights; cannot yet run on physical hardware.

events.label: $14.1M seed
events.detail: Led by Kindred Ventures. The only disclosed equity.

events.label: Up to $75M, Commerce LOI
events.detail: A non-binding letter of intent, subject to definitive agreements.

caption: Two chips, three open-source projects and a model family on one 2023 seed, and every piece of software has shipped before the hardware it targets is available. The two hollow markers are the whole of the next twelve months.
source: Extropic announcements; PRNewswire, December 2023; NIST, July 29, 2026.
